title: Deploy Containers to AWS ECS with Fargate
title_es: Desplegar Contenedores en ECS con Fargate
description: Runnable Terraform + GitHub Actions companion for the ECS Fargate recipe: VPC with NAT, ECS cluster, task definition, ALB service, IAM roles, autoscaling and Secrets Manager wiring.
description_es: Proyecto Terraform + GitHub Actions ejecutable para la receta de ECS Fargate: VPC con NAT, cluster ECS, definición de tarea, servicio con ALB, roles IAM, autoescalado e integración con Secrets Manager.
